title: installed-artifact live-browser DOM evidence for the Teams console

driver.always_rebuilds_reason: A reused build or a reused prefix silently produces evidence for code that is no longer on disk, which is exactly the boundary this unit exists to close. The producer runs pnpm build:governance, npm pack and npm install on every run.

canonical_run.cleanup: every owned pid dead (47560, 47754, 47950, 52006, 52814); 0 processes matched the owned temp root; 0 processes matched the owned Chrome profile; the owned temp root was removed

installed_artifact.staged_by: pnpm build:governance (pnpm build && node scripts/package-artifact.mjs --mode final)
installed_artifact.install: npm pack <pack root> --pack-destination <owned root>/pack, then npm install --prefix <owned root>/prefix --no-audit --no-fund <tarball>

provenance.claim: the daemons that served the page were the installed copy, and the bytes the browser received were the installed package's files
measured_facts: the control daemon's own command line runs <installed root>/generated/runtime-lib/runtime/control-process.js
the control daemon's own control-state.json records entryPath=<installed root>/generated/runtime-lib/runtime/control-process.js
the agent daemon's own command line runs <installed root>/cli/agentteams.mjs
no process command line contains the source worktree path
the document served for GET / is byte-identical to the installed console-host/static/console.html (sha256 2b9ebd60aab3baf1e0f93ce910db30e872884a1f0c88bc8f8962861c61820e21)
the served /console-entry.js is byte-identical to the installed console-host/static/console-entry.js (343 bytes, sha256 d67e55de91996771f6e011cbeaf746bdc9ac7dc3643dab70787af4fbfc67f636)
the served /ui/browser.js is byte-identical to the installed ui/teams-console/browser.js (273 bytes, sha256 7ea6a860c73a9b712b883464451b2958c0ecf126db4fb2e578c80043844c39e0)
all 18 /ui/* modules the page received are byte-identical to their installed package counterpart
provenance.not_claimed: no restart, no deployed-entrypoint replay, no cross-device receipt, no mobile layout, and no control-daemon Session or permission write

gates.installed_artifact_install: pass (tarball packed and installed into an isolated prefix outside the source tree)
gates.installed_daemon_start: pass (registry, real --serve opencode agent with a real engine child, and control, all from the installed CLI)
gates.installed_provenance: pass (process command lines and the daemon's own state entry path all resolve inside the install)
gates.served_asset_provenance: pass (document and every served /ui/ module byte-match the installed package)
gates.real_control_daemon: pass (installed origin, real listener, real Basic challenge)
gates.clean_origin_cdp_navigation: pass (clean URL, no userinfo, credential injected with Network.setExtraHTTPHeaders)
gates.authenticated_page_fetch: pass (the page's own fetch reached the installed origin)
gates.live_dom: pass (frozen D07 markers present in the live DOM of the installed entry)
gates.shipped_page_own_sse_subscription: pass (the entry opened its own /api/v1/events and reached observation=live)
gates.live_page_navigation: pass (all four frozen views rendered in real Chrome)
gates.screenshot_png: pass (756x469, 28255 bytes, dimensions read from the IHDR chunk)
gates.process_cleanup: pass (all owned pids dead, no strays, owned temp root removed)

defects_found_in_the_producer.summary: The first module-provenance loop rebuilt its request table per module and compared record objects by identity, so every lookup returned undefined and zero modules were compared while the check still printed a pass.
defects_found_in_the_producer.resolution: The table is built once, and the check asserts comparedModules === moduleEntries.length so an uncompared module fails the run.

defects_found_in_the_producer.summary: The first canonical run reported a console error count without naming the errors.
defects_found_in_the_producer.resolution: The producer now reports the verbatim texts and binds them to the observed Network table; any failed request other than the expected /favicon.ico 404 fails the run.

gaps.name: event-driven DOM markers
gaps.reason: data-team-cancel and data-permission-option are only emitted for a rendered Session. This control daemon binds no Session owner, so no Session exists to cancel and no permission is pending. Their absence is the same gap D06/D08 already records and is not treated as evidence here.

gaps.name: history rows through the installed entry
gaps.reason: The history view renders data-history-count=0 with 0 rows in this configuration. The marker render is proven; a non-empty history row is not.

scope_note: This artifact proves the installed package serves the frozen D07 console to a real browser whose page fetches, subscribes and renders from that origin, and that the bytes the browser received are the installed package's files. It does not prove restart, a deployed-entrypoint replay, cross-device behaviour, mobile layout, or any control-daemon Session/permission write. The D07 gate therefore stays partial.
